qualification.details: Project Associate-I: MSc/MTech in Life Sciences/ Biotechnology/ Molecular biology/ Biochemistry/ Microbiology/Genomics. Any National level eligibility test qualified such as GATE, NET, DBT etc. One-year prior experience in yeast genetics, molecular biology, along with demonstrated experience in epigenetics research. Desirable skills include the use of epigenetic techniques such as chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP), co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP), and related assays to study protein-DNA and protein-protein interactions. Prior involvement in functional genomics or transcriptional regulation projects will be considered a plus.

salary_details.details: Project Associate-I: Rs.25,000/- + 27% HRA per month

content_sections.text: Project Associate-I: MSc/MTech in Life Sciences/ Biotechnology/ Molecular biology/ Biochemistry/ Microbiology/Genomics. Any National level eligibility test qualified such as GATE, NET, DBT etc. One-year prior experience in yeast genetics, molecular biology, along with demonstrated experience in epigenetics research. Prior involvement in functional genomics or transcriptional regulation projects will be considered a plus.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Associate-I position at RCB?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Project Associate-I position at the Regional Centre for Biotechnology is 05th October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an MSc/MTech in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, or Genomics, and have qualified in a national-level eligibility test like GATE, NET, or DBT.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 28 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month, plus 27% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Associate-I position at the Regional Centre for Biotechnology.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official website of the Regional Centre for Biotechnology.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an online interview for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any prior experience required for this role?
faq.answer: Yes, one year of prior experience in yeast genetics and molecular biology is required, along with demonstrated experience in epigenetics research.

faq.question: Q9. What are the desirable skills for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: Desirable skills include experience with epigenetic techniques like ChIP and Co-IP, and prior involvement in functional genomics or transcriptional regulation projects.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Regional Centre for Biotechnology located?
faq.answer: The Regional Centre for Biotechnology is located in Faridabad, Haryana.
